name: Knowing Right From Wrong
overview: Scripture reveals that knowing right from wrong is rooted in God's Word being treasured in the heart to prevent sin, as Psalms 119:11 emphasizes. God clearly shows what is good, calling believers to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Him (Micah 6:8). Jesus teaches the importance of treating others as we want to be treated, summarizing the law and prophets in this principle (Matthew 7:12). Recognizing human weakness, believers are urged to watch and pray to resist temptation and avoid evil (Matthew 26:41; Matthew 6:13), understanding that true defilement comes from what proceeds out of the heart (Mark 7:20).
